Asha (PM): Quick mid-quarter check — can owners confirm OKR milestone statuses for 'Model routing v2' and 'KV cache rollouts'? What shipped vs slipped, and any CR/QA blockers?
Miguel (Eng): Model routing v2: core routing logic shipped last week, canary running in us-west. Still pending canary perf validation for long-context (>=8k).
Priya (Eng): KV cache rollouts: partial rollout to Dedicated pool A finished; noticed a regression in cold-start latency for some flows — working on a fix, PR up.
Asha (PM): Thanks. Please give concrete next steps and owners for the residual items so we can update the milestone board.
Miguel (Eng): Next steps: 1) finish long-context perf eval (owner: Miguel), ETA Wed EOD; 2) toggle canary to 50% if perf looks stable (owner: Sam).
Priya (Eng): KV cache next steps: 1) PR #341 addresses cold-start mem init (owner: Priya), needs CR & perf test; 2) QA validation in staging (owner: Lina). ETA Thu for full rollout if green.
Lina (QA): I can start QA runs once PR is merged — please @me when ready. I'll run the 8k+ prompt battery and regression suite.
Sam (Infra): FYI, if we flip canary to 50% we should ensure autoscaling headroom in us-west; I'll reserve a small bump for the window.
deploy-bot: Deployment event recorded: canary start for routing-v2 at 1766524300 by Miguel (Eng). :white_check_mark:
Asha (PM): PR/CR status? Priya, Miguel — link the PRs and current blockers so I can mark shipped/slipped on the tracker.
Priya (Eng): PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/341 — needs 1 more reviewer and a perf run. Blocker: intermittent cold-start spike on T4 nodes.
Miguel (Eng): Routing PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/347 — merged. Canary perf pending (see above).
Priya (Eng): @Lina once QA confirms the perf run is stable I can merge and trigger rollout.
Lina (QA): I'll kick off runs now, ping when the PR build finishes.
Asha (PM): Summary for the milestone board (proposed): "Model routing v2: shipped -> canary; final perf validation in progress (owner: Miguel, ETA Wed). KV cache rollouts: partial rollout; blocked by cold-start regression -> PR #341 (owner: Priya), QA in progress (owner: Lina), ETA Thu if green." Agree or update?
Sam (Infra): Agree with that summary. I'll note the infra bump during canary in the rollouts doc.
Miguel (Eng): Agree. If canary perf holds I'll flip to 50% Thu morning and notify infra.
Priya (Eng): Agree. If QA finds issues we'll cut a hotfix branch and re-run quick perf tests.
Asha (PM): Great — I'll update the OKR board and send an async note to execs summarizing shipped vs at-risk items. Thanks everyone :rocket:
Miguel (Eng): Quick CR ping: @Priya I left comments on #341 about mem init path; should be quick.
Priya (Eng): Got it, applying shortly.
Lina (QA): PR build finished, starting tests now.
Asha (PM): If anything slips beyond Thu EOD please flag asap so we can adjust comms.
Priya (Eng): Will do.
Sam (Infra): I'll log the temporary node reservation, ETA window Thu 9:00-12:00 PT.
Asha (PM): Perfect — closing the loop. If no major blockers by Thu morning we'll call KV rollout on-track.
